title: Gujarat Smart School Project
card: A 12-month renovation of a working school campus: painting, waterproofing, structural repair, landscaping and new fittings.
facts: Gujarat Smart School project, municipal primary school
lead: Over 12 months in 2022-23, LOKI Infra renovated the Gujarat Smart School buildings in Limbayat, Surat. One team handled painting and waterproofing, structural crack repair, landscape development and the replacement of doors, windows and locks, all while the school remained in use.
scope: Every interior and exterior repainted, with waterproofing treatments to keep moisture out and extend the life of the buildings.
Cracks, breaks and tears in walls repaired and redeveloped, leaving the buildings structurally sound as well as better looking.
New gardens and green spaces across the grounds, giving students better places to learn and play.
Windows, doors and locks replaced and restored for better security, safety and everyday comfort.
highlights: The buildings stayed in use during the works, so every package was planned around students' safety.
Painting, waterproofing, repair, landscaping and fittings under a single contract.
Waterproofing and structural repair address the causes of damage, not just the finish.

title: Zota Healthcare Factory and Warehouse
card: Factory and warehouse facilities built for a pharmaceutical manufacturer inside Surat's Special Economic Zone.
facts: Siddh Sai Corporation, LOKI Infra's group company
lead: Siddh Sai Corporation constructed the factory and warehouse facilities for Zota Healthcare in the Surat SEZ. Pharmaceutical buildings leave no room for loose workmanship: production and storage spaces have to be built clean, sound and on schedule so the client can move into operation without delay.
scope: Civil and structural works for the manufacturing facility.
A dedicated storage facility built alongside the factory.
Factory and warehouse built as one coordinated job, ready for the client to move into operation.
highlights: Pharmaceutical facilities need consistent quality in every slab, wall and finish.
Work delivered within the rules and access controls of a Special Economic Zone.
Two connected facilities built as one coordinated job.

title: 16 Power Loom Factories, Sachin GIDC
card: Sixteen power loom factory units, Nos. 30 to 45, built for Surat's textile industry in PTO Sachin GIDC.
facts: Siddh Sai Corporation, LOKI Infra's group company
lead: Siddh Sai Corporation built sixteen power loom factories, units 30 to 45, in PTO Sachin GIDC. Repeating one factory type sixteen times demands discipline: every unit had to match the last in quality while the programme kept moving, so owners could install looms and start production.
scope: Civil and structural construction of 16 power loom units.
Sixteen units built in sequence to one consistent standard.
Each unit completed so owners could move on to installing looms.
highlights: Sixteen factory buildings delivered as one series.
Facilities for the textile weaving trade that drives the city.
The same quality from the first unit to the last.

title: Industrial Construction, Sachin GIDC
card: Multiple industrial construction projects delivered in one of Surat's largest industrial estates.
facts: Siddh Sai Corporation, LOKI Infra's group company
lead: Sachin GIDC is one of Surat's busiest industrial estates, and Siddh Sai Corporation has delivered multiple industrial construction projects there. Building again and again in the same estate gives the team deep knowledge of local conditions, approvals and how to build for production.
scope: Construction of factory and industrial units.
Foundations, frames, walls and slabs built for industrial use.
highlights: Years of work inside one estate means fewer surprises on site.
A track record built project by project in the same location.
Buildings that suit how factories actually run.

title: Printing Units Maintenance, Pandesara, Sachin and Kadodara

lead: Siddh Sai Corporation carried out civil repairs, fabrication and renovation for printing units across Pandesara, Sachin and Kadodara. Maintenance in an industrial unit is its own skill: the work has to be fast, safe and planned around production, because downtime costs the owner money.
scope: Repairs to keep the units structurally sound and safe.
Steel fabrication work for plant needs.
Upgrades to keep the units efficient and fit for purpose.
highlights: Work spread across Pandesara, Sachin and Kadodara.
Repairs scheduled to keep disruption low.
Repair, fabrication and renovation skills in one team.

Wall preparation and finishing to retail standard.
Steel fabrication for the building's needs.

Six packages, from heavy civil work to fine finishes.
Surfaces built to look right and survive heavy use.

Repairs and strengthening of depot structures.
Renovation of depot buildings and facilities.

Facilities renewed for years of heavy, everyday use.

facts: Siddh Sai Corporation, LOKI Infra's group company

scope: Roof and terrace systems that keep the rain out.
External and internal treatments against dampness.
highlights: A core strength of the group for decades.
Systems chosen to last, not just to pass handover.

Projects across Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh.
Electrical infrastructure built to utility standards.

Logistics and supervision for remote locations.

RCC tanks supporting local water supply.
Quality delivered far from urban supply chains.
